Install or update on macOS and Linux:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://danieltyukov.github.io/albertheijn-mcp/install.sh | sh
```

On Windows (PowerShell):

```powershell
irm https://danieltyukov.github.io/albertheijn-mcp/install.ps1 | iex
```

Or with npm: `npm install -g https://github.com/danieltyukov/albertheijn-mcp/releases/latest/download/albertheijn-mcp.tgz`

The changes in this version are listed in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/danieltyukov/albertheijn-mcp/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
